driver: STM32N6 general-purpose I/O (GPIOA) hardware abstraction layer (HAL) driver as delivered by ST (STM32CubeN6 v1.4.0)

target.safety_allocation: NOT_PROVIDED: no owner safety scope recorded for the GPIO benchmark work orders
target.hsi_contract: RM0486 Rev 4 ch.15 GPIO register interface (instance base address and register map derived by the onboarding stage)

scope: ST's classic HAL GPIO driver as delivered (STM32CubeN6 v1.4.0), used as is (FROZEN), for port A (GPIOA)
Pin configuration: input, output push-pull/open-drain, alternate function and analog modes, output speed, pull-up/pull-down and alternate function selection of the selected pins
Pin data: read a pin, set or reset a pin, toggle pins, set and reset several pins at once; the pin configuration lock
Out of scope: external interrupt/event modes and callbacks, pin de-initialisation, retime/delay settings, secure/privilege attributes, other ports

budgets.status: development targets set by the work-order owner (2026-10-15), reused for the feature 015 benchmark set (2026-10-25)

guideline: inputs/hal_driver_guideline.md (ST Cube2 HAL SAD v1.2; automated subset = checklist SWE3-07)
layer_note: Feature 016 acceptance (owner 2026-10-27, feature 015 T065): ST's existing STM32CubeN6 HAL code, FROZEN, onboarded by the factory from the owner inputs alone - the delivery file map, framework modules, peripheral profile and prompt texts are derived and owner-approved, not written by hand; requirements are derived from RM0486 independently of the code; secure build.

packages.origin: CMSIS core headers shipped in STMicroelectronics STM32CubeN6 v1.4.0

scope.note: blocking/polling HAL API of the scope; MSP hooks, interrupt/DMA paths excluded
